name: Cascara + conga tumbao
desc: Latin-jazz engine room in 2-3 clave: woodblock cascara on the shell, conga marcha with slap on 2 and open tones on the and-of-4, clave keeping the key pattern underneath; peak doubles the cascara and answers with agogo.

gain.doc: level (vcsl perc is quiet - keep high)

code.sparse: stack(s("conga ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ conga [conga ~] ~ ~ conga ~ ~ ~ conga ~").speed("[1.25 0 0 0 0 0 1 1 0 0 1.25 0 0 0 1 0]").gain(${gain}).shape(.4), s("~ ~ clave ~ clave ~ ~ ~ clave ~ ~ clave ~ ~ clave ~").slow(2).gain(${gain}*.7).shape(.3).pan(.4)).fast(${rate}).room(.2).orbit(2).play()
code.full: stack(s("woodblock ~ woodblock ~ woodblock woodblock ~ woodblock woodblock ~ woodblock woodblock ~ woodblock woodblock ~").gain("[.42 0 .3 0 .36 .3 0 .34 .4 0 .3 .32 0 .34 .3 0]").shape(.45).hpf(${cut}*.35).lpf(${cut}*1.6).pan(.62), s("~ ~ conga ~ ~ ~ conga [conga conga] ~ ~ conga ~ ~ ~ conga [conga conga]").speed("[0 0 1.3 0 0 0 1 [1 1] 0 0 1.3 0 0 0 1 [1 .92]]").gain(${gain}).shape(.45), s("~ ~ clave ~ clave ~ ~ ~ clave ~ ~ clave ~ ~ clave ~").slow(2).gain(${gain}*.8).shape(.35).pan(.4)).fast(${rate}).room(.22).orbit(2).play()
code.peak: stack(s("woodblock ~ woodblock ~ woodblock woodblock ~ woodblock woodblock ~ woodblock woodblock ~ woodblock woodblock ~").gain("[.46 0 .34 0 .4 .34 0 .38 .44 0 .34 .36 0 .38 .34 0]").shape(.5).hpf(${cut}*.35).lpf(${cut}*1.7).pan(.64), s("~ ~ conga ~ ~ ~ conga [conga conga] ~ ~ conga conga ~ ~ conga [conga conga]").speed("[0 0 1.3 0 0 0 1 [1 1] 0 0 1.3 1.15 0 0 1 [1 .92]]").gain(${gain}).shape(.5), s("~ ~ clave ~ clave ~ ~ ~ clave ~ ~ clave ~ ~ clave ~").slow(2).gain(${gain}*.85).shape(.4).pan(.38), s("agogo(3,8,<2 5>)").speed("<1 1.22>").gain(${gain}*.55).shape(.35).hpf(900).pan(.7).every(8, x=>x.ply(2))).fast(${rate}).room(.22).orbit(2).play()
